item.description: Historic maps of Buffalo are not only interesting to observe, they also help to tell important stories about the ever-changing landscape of this city’s neighborhoods. Such is the case with a sub-division map for the Central Park Bennett-Pierce Tract. item.title: Ruben Studdard joins the BPO for a Valentine’s Weekend Tribute to Luther Vandross
item.description: This Valentine’s Day Weekend, American Idol Ruben Studdard joins the Buffalo Philharmonic Orchestra (BPO) for an incredible night of music and soul. Studdard will perform the songs of one of his inspirations in a program entitled My Tribute to Luther Vandross.
